text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "keeps hourly RDB snapshots for the latest 48 hours",
      "claim_text": "A common backup scheme keeps hourly RDB snapshots for the latest 48 hours.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P0.S1 gives hourly snapshots for latest 48 hours as an example."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "daily snapshots for one or two months",
      "claim_text": "The scheme keeps daily snapshots for one or two months.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P0.S1 mentions daily snapshots for one or two months."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "up to 48 hourly files",
      "claim_text": "Keeping hourly snapshots for 48 hours means up to 48 hourly files.",
      "kind": "arith",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "48", "op": "==", "value": "48"},
      "reasoning": "48 hours of hourly snapshots gives 48 files."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "as many as about 60 daily files",
      "claim_text": "Keeping daily snapshots for two months means as many as about 60 daily files.",
      "kind": "arith",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "2 * 30", "op": "==", "value": "60"},
      "reasoning": "Two months at 30 days each is about 60 daily files."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "At least once a day a snapshot should be transferred outside the data center",
      "claim_text": "At least once a day a snapshot should be transferred outside the data center.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S3", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P0.S3 states this requirement."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "or at least outside the physical machine",
      "claim_text": "Alternatively, a snapshot should be transferred at least outside the physical machine.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S3", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P0.S3 allows outside the physical machine as an alternative."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Redis can save the dataset every N seconds if there have been at least M changes",
      "claim_text": "Redis can save the dataset every N seconds if there have been at least M changes.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P3.S1 states this configuration."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "with a save point of 300 seconds and 100 changes, a crash can never lose more than five minutes of writes",
      "claim_text": "With a save point of 300 seconds and 100 changes, a crash can never lose more than five minutes of writes.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": false,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P2.S1", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P2.S2", "rel": "refutes"}
      ],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P2.S2 says you should be prepared to lose the latest minutes of data, contradicting 'never'."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Snapshots sent to S3 should be encrypted",
      "claim_text": "Snapshots sent to S3 should be encrypted.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P5.S1 says transfer RDB snapshot to S3 in encrypted form."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "for example with gpg -c",
      "claim_text": "Encryption can be done for example with gpg -c.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P5.S2 mentions gpg -c for encryption."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the password stored in several safe places",
      "claim_text": "The password should be stored in several safe places.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S3", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P5.S3 says store password in many different safe places."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "If you push backups to a VPS over SCP, verifying the file size after the transfer is enough to guarantee the backup is intact",
      "claim_text": "Verifying the file size after transfer is enough to guarantee the backup is intact.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": false,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S1", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P6.S1 says verify file size and possibly SHA1 digest, not that size alone is enough."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "With appendfsync no, Linux typically flushes data every 30 seconds",
      "claim_text": "With appendfsync no, Linux typically flushes data every 30 seconds.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S7", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P4.S7 states this typical behavior."
    }
  ]
}
